question: Drug used in triple drug therapy of H. Pylori:
analysis: Triple therapy for H. pylori typically includes a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) and two antibiotics. Metronidazole is one of the commonly used antibiotics in this regimen, especially in areas where clarithromycin resistance is high. Erythromycin, ciprofloxacin, and aminoglycosides are not standard components of the traditional triple therapy for H. pylori.
